dict.string: Petasos needs microphone access to transcribe your speech for the hermes-agent companion. Audio is processed locally via on-device Parakeet (MLX) by default, never sent to a third party unless you switch to the HTTP backend in Settings.
Petasos talks to your hermes-agent server, which may be running on this Mac or another machine on your local network. No data is sent anywhere else.

Petasos can capture system audio so transcription and Claude's responses can account for what's playing on your Mac. Audio is processed on-device by default and never leaves your machine unless you enable an HTTP transcription backend.
